pages.text: Precision Prospecting adds three additional kinds of prospecting tools with different ranges which can be used to enhance your prospecting expeditions.

$(li)The $(l:precisionprospecting/prospector_hammer)Prospector's Hammer$() is similar to a regular $(l:mechanics/prospecting#propick)Prospector's Pick$() just with a smaller range.$(li)The $(l:precisionprospecting/prospector_drill)Prospector's Drill$() is a directional prospector which has a non-cuboid, off-center scanning area$(li)The $(l:precisionprospecting/mineral_prospector)Mineral Prospector$() has a larger scanning area, but only detects $(thing)non-metal ores$().
